name: Editorial Intent Fidelity
hypothesis: Explicitly requiring Narrative to preserve Synthesis editorial hierarchy will keep the company identity and ambition central, present Compose as the first concrete step, and keep orchestration subordinate.
baselineProvenance: Reused three completed baseline runs from experiment-004-opening-and-ending/baseline because all 11 prompt files, source input, commit, and console configuration matched this experiment baseline exactly.
buildCandidate: dotnet build src/Nueyon.Compose.slnx: passed, 0 warnings, 0 errors
buildRestored: dotnet build src/Nueyon.Compose.slnx: passed, 0 warnings, 0 errors
testsRestored: dotnet test src/Nueyon.Compose.slnx --no-build: 165 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped; Domain had no discoverable tests
promotion: Not promoted; production prompt restored byte-for-byte to baseline.
limitations: Baseline was run on 2026-11-03 and candidate runs on 2026-11-04; model alias may be served by a changing provider backend.
No temperature or seed control is configured, so n=3 samples are descriptive, not statistically conclusive.
The archived original-instruction.txt is preserved as experiment context; the console workflow itself consumes Markdown files from data/input and has no separate instruction argument.
Idea selection is deterministic first-result selection in the application, but generated Idea and Research text varies between runs.
